# Forge

> Forge is a habit app for building good habits and breaking bad ones, made Muslim-first: prayers, Quran, dhikr,
> Ramadan and Fajr sit next to screen time limits, quitting smoking or vaping, journaling, focus timers and everyday
> habits, with friends and family in groups. It also has a General mode without worship features.
> Available in English, Arabic and Turkish. iPhone launches 11 January 2027; Android and iPhone↔Android groups follow
> on 1 February 2027, before Ramadan.

## Key facts
- Platforms: iPhone (iOS 26+, Apple Watch, widgets, Live Activities); Android from 1 February 2027.
- Pricing: free for up to 5 habits; Premium monthly, yearly or lifetime with a 7-day trial; founders' prices until 12 March 2027.
- Privacy: habits stay on the phone and the person's own iCloud; no ads; Screen Time and Health data never leave the phone.
- Faith features: five daily prayers with times, Wake for Fajr alarm, Quran reading and Team Khatma, dhikr counters,
  Ramadan and Hijri-season habits, Guard Your Gaze, Guard Your Tongue.
- Break habits: Less Social Media / Video / Gaming / One App plans, Block Apps, Phone Down at Bedtime, Quit Smoking/Vaping
  with money-saved counter and urge help.
- Groups: shared habits, Team Khatma, collective dhikr; works between iPhone and Android.
